retrievalProfile.description: A 1980s-style album cover featuring a soft-focus tropical portrait framed by high-contrast geometric color blocks and promotional sticker overlays.
triggerTerms: tropical studio portrait with color blocks

recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body studio portrait of a woman in tropical attire, set against a dark, misty green background. The composition is defined by a diagonal yellow corner block in the top right and a rectangular green 'hype sticker' overlay, creating a layered, collage-like depth typical of 1980s vinyl packaging.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically but offset to the left by geometric overlays
High-contrast relationship between dark green background and bright yellow/red graphic elements
Soft, diffused lighting on the subject contrasting with sharp-edged graphic blocks
Diagonal movement created by the top-right yellow wedge and the angled sticker
coreInvariants: Primary color accents (red, yellow) against a secondary green base
Geometric layering of text blocks over the photographic plane

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body kneeling subject, occupying the left two-thirds of the frame at medium-large scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright yellow diagonal block in the top right corner acts as the primary anchor for the title.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top-right yellow block, follow the diagonal down to the green sticker, then move left to the subject's face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep green, misty negative space surrounds the subject, providing a canvas for the graphic overlays.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep forest green (background and sticker base)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in graphic elements; medium saturation and low value in the photographic background.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon pinks or purples to maintain the specific early-80s tropical palette

letterConstructionRules: Overlapping characters in the main title
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the main title are tightly packed so they physically touch or overlap

composition.relationshipToImage: Layered on top of color block

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold geometric display face paired with a lighter, slanted sans-serif for a dynamic, commercial feel.

preserve: Diagonal layout of the top-right corner

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and geometric simplicity

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus studio portrait of a woman in a colorful tropical wrap, kneeling against a dark, misty green background. Include a bright yellow diagonal wedge in the top right corner and a solid green rectangle with rounded corners in the upper right quadrant.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply bold, red geometric sans-serif text inside the yellow wedge with characters touching. Add slanted, dark sans-serif text just below it. Fill the green rectangle with white, centered sans-serif text in various weights.

verificationChecks: Is the top-right yellow block diagonal?
Does the main title text have touching/overlapping characters?
Is the background a soft-focus, dark green tropical setting?
Is there a green 'sticker' rectangle with white text?

adjustableVariables: Text content on the hype sticker
mustRedesign: Original album title and artist name

mustAchieve: Authentic 80s film grain and soft focus

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the yellow block is a clean diagonal cut.
Verify the red text is extra-bold and tightly spaced.
Check that the green sticker has a subtle white border.
Confirm the photographic subject has a soft, diffused glow.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Soft-Focus Tropical Portrait] + [Diagonal Color Block Anchor] + [Overlapping Geometric Typography] + [Hype Sticker Overlay] to recreate the 80s pop vinyl look.
